purpose: Define how a frozen rare RNA/target program (for example a STAT1-like lead) will be tested in GSE214979 using RNA and ATAC from the same physical nucleus without allowing multimodal evidence to redefine the RNA program after outcome inspection.

prerequisites.identity_conflict_rule: Primary deciding analysis excludes HCT17HEX and HCTZZT unless an independently authenticated correction predates outcome opening.

assay_steps.name: RNA_PROGRAM_SCORING
assay_steps.rule: Score the already frozen RNA/target program in every eligible nucleus without using ATAC to alter the score, membership, threshold, direction or query definition.

assay_steps.name: WITHIN_DONOR_ATAC_CONTRAST
assay_steps.rule: Within donor, compare ATAC accessibility between nuclei with stronger versus weaker frozen program state using predeclared continuous or thresholded contrasts. Nucleus count improves precision but donor remains the replication unit.

assay_steps.name: REGULATORY_FEATURE_TEST
assay_steps.rule: Test predeclared STAT1-like motif/peak/region-gene sets and matched/random regulatory controls. Stage75/cisTarget features are supporting hypotheses, not validated truth.

assay_steps.name: DONOR_RECURRENCE
assay_steps.rule: Require directionally coherent within-donor ATAC association across multiple donors. A pooled nucleus-level association cannot establish multimodal coherence.

assay_steps.name: SHORTCUT_FALSIFICATION
assay_steps.rule: Challenge the association against depth, detected genes, RNA library size, ATAC fragments/library size, feature support, source/library/operator and query abundance where applicable.

assay_steps.name: RARE_STATE_SHARPENING_OR_SPLITTING
assay_steps.rule: Ask whether ATAC adds a coherent regulatory dimension to the frozen RNA state, splits it into reproducible sub-states, leaves it unchanged, or falsifies a regulatory interpretation. Any split is a post-freeze multimodal annotation and cannot retroactively redefine the foundation target.

assay_steps.name: RNA_RECOVERABILITY
assay_steps.rule: Using donor-held-out evaluation, estimate how much of the ATAC/regulatory increment can be predicted from lawful RNA evidence.

primary_outputs.program_atac_coherence: donor-level direction and uncertainty for frozen program versus matched controls
primary_outputs.regulatory_specificity: whether predeclared regulatory features outperform matched/random features without claiming causality
primary_outputs.privileged_increment: difference between RNA+ATAC teacher state and RNA-only teacher state
primary_outputs.recoverable_fraction: fraction of privileged increment reproducibly predictable from RNA under donor holdout
primary_outputs.teacher_private_fraction: coherent privileged biology not reproducibly recoverable from RNA
primary_outputs.falsification_result: whether observed ATAC coherence disappears under measurement/operator controls

decision_classes.MULTIMODAL_SHARED_RECOVERABLE: RNA program has donor-recurrent ATAC/regulatory coherence and substantial increment is RNA-recoverable.
decision_classes.MULTIMODAL_SHARED_PARTLY_PRIVATE: RNA program has donor-recurrent ATAC/regulatory coherence but only part of the increment is RNA-recoverable.
decision_classes.MULTIMODAL_TEACHER_PRIVATE: ATAC/regulatory coherence is donor-recurrent but not reproducibly predictable from RNA; retain as teacher-private biology/uncertainty.
decision_classes.RNA_STATE_WITHOUT_REGULATORY_INCREMENT: Frozen RNA state is reproducible but no qualified same-nucleus ATAC increment is detected despite sufficient support.
decision_classes.REGULATORY_INTERPRETATION_FALSIFIED: Apparent coherence is explained by measurement/operator controls or matched controls.

candidate_specific_notes.C1: Test whether rare shared-state structure has multimodal regulatory coherence.
candidate_specific_notes.C3: Control explicitly for query abundance and detection so q-conditioned rarity is not merely high expression of q.
candidate_specific_notes.C6: Test whether shared+query rare structure has multimodal coherence beyond the stronger constituent C1/C3.
candidate_specific_notes.C2_C4: Only if relational replay leaves them active; test relational rare states without allowing graph/source structure to stand in for biology.

nonrescue_rules: Same-nucleus ATAC cannot select or rescue a failed foundation target.
ATAC cannot be used to edit the frozen rare RNA direction after outcome opening.
A donor-pooled nucleus-level p-value is not biological replication.
A motif enrichment is not causal regulator proof.
Failure of RNA recoverability does not imply absence of biology; it may define teacher-private state.
next_layer: After classification here, donor-level recurrence is tested in Morabito separate-nucleus RNA/ATAC and regulatory interpretation is compared with SCENIC+/Stage75 evidence.
non_authority_statement: This file freezes an assay only. It authorizes no target selection, multimodal execution, representation selection, TD60, Stage4 or training.
